title: Cerebras CEO says we’re nearing a future where everyone has a personal AI assistant at home
slides: Cerebras CEO: Your personal AI assistant is closer than you think.
The key is ultra-fast chips that process data in memory.
But don't expect privacy—your assistant may need to share data.
Your next home device could learn your habits without cloud delays.
Start planning for on-device AI; it will change daily routines.
thread_text:
1. Your AI, No Cloud

Cerebras CEO says your personal AI assistant is closer than you think, powered by chips that process data in memory.

2. Ultra-Fast Chips

The secret is on-chip memory that eliminates cloud delays, so your assistant responds instantly.

3. Privacy Trade-Off

But don't expect privacy—your assistant may need to share your data to learn and improve.

4. Home Devices Learn

Your next home device could pick up your habits without sending everything to the cloud.

5. Get Ready Now

Start planning for on-device AI today. How will you adapt your daily routine when it arrives?
